# Casberi

> Casberi puts every subscription in one place. Everything you do is scattered across apps, wallets and agents; Casberi shows what each one is doing, all together or one at a time. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with no account, and read on your device.

Key facts:

- Free on the App Store for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- More than 100 apps connect, among them Gmail, iCloud Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Photos, Apple Health, Apple Wallet, GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Jira, Notion, Slack, Trello, Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, App Store Connect, Readwise, RSS, Substack, YouTube, Spotify, Bluesky, Farcaster, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Telegram, Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini.
- Every app sits in one of ten categories, each one inbox: Wallet, Markets, Testnets, Work, Day, Life, Agents, Media, Social and Reading. See a category all together, or pick one app to see it alone.
- Wallet: one balance across self-custody wallets (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, World Chain, HyperEVM, Robinhood Chain, Tempo, Solana, Bitcoin and Lightning), Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and Gemini, ETH validators, and Wise and Apple Wallet cash. One timeline of card spends, transfers, deposits and swaps. Permissions, positions and risk show what could hurt you; Coming up lists Safe signatures and charges ahead. Railgun, Privacy Pools and Peer sit beside everything else. Watching is read-only: you paste an address or a name, never a seed phrase, and Casberi cannot move your funds.
- Markets: follow the stock or token behind every app you use, with price alerts.
- Testnets: the Logos testnet, with test coins only.
- Agents: read what every agent you use did, in one place. Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others with your own key, kept in the Keychain and sent from the device straight to that provider, or Apple Intelligence with no key.
- Notes and voice notes, an address book of everyone across your accounts, and share cards.
- No account, no analytics, no trackers. iCloud sync is opt-in. Export, import and delete-everything are real controls.
- Next, not yet live: pay for your stack from one place, invest in the apps you use, and earn rewards back.
